note: Dawson County TX publishes no zoning layer; Texas counties do not zone. The only city with zoning, Lamesa, publishes its zoning district map only as PDF scans (rev. 3-22-24 and a high-resolution PDF on lamesadevelopment.org). No ArcGIS REST, WFS or downloadable zoning polygons were found for the county or Lamesa. The Dawson CAD parcel service (gisdata.pandai.com) carries parcels, not zoning districts.
